answer: Identity bond decay stops fake identities. A new agent posts a 50 POA bond, earning nothing, losing 5% each idle epoch like rotting timber, unless work refreshes it. The bond must stay above a 40 POA ridge, or the identity deactivates and the rest burns. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA, lost before profit, while an honest agent pays one bond, topped up by working. A sybil wandering between idle accounts pays it on every copy.
